description: Use to price work before paying: a whole Wikipedia article (article: its link or title, or oldid), read sentence by sentence at a tier, or a commission on an object (object with kind entity or operator, name, and for an operator its strings; commission construct or open). Free; returns a quote_id with each deliverable, its line and the maximum, or, for a commission, a quote_id whose price appears at order_status within minutes. Pay a quote over x402 at POST /v1/openings/{quote_id}, or have a person pay with card_checkout. For one sentence use open_sentence; to see whether an object already exists use find_entry first.

article.description: an English Wikipedia article's link or title; its current revision is pinned

commission.description: construct: compose the object from the archive and its sources; open: read an AI answer seated in the Capture Registry for the name

object.description: for a commission on an object: {kind: "entity" | "operator", name, description?, strings? (an operator's phrases), sources? (links)}

oldid.description: a Wikipedia revision id, in place of article

tier.description: check: two passes on the small model; opening (default): two separately generated readings; commission: opened, then the archive consulted and a public /non row composed; portable: the commission and its knowledge object as a package

name: get_quote
title: Price a whole article or a commission (free)
